title: Restore default SIRead granularity caps (page=2, relation=-2)
configuration_cause: Incumbent runs degenerate zero caps max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0, forcing immediate promotion of every SIRead lock to coarser granularity; this maximizes promotion churn per GetUserTweets scan rather than minimizing it.
mechanism: With page cap 0 and relation cap 0, every predicate lock is promoted immediately to the coarsest granularity, so each GetUserTweets scan performs maximal promotion bookkeeping and holds coarse relation-level SIRead locks that inflate locks_total and lengthen the p99 tail. Restoring PostgreSQL defaults (page=2, relation=-2, i.e. relation cap derived as a fraction of the per-txn budget) keeps locks at page granularity longer, cutting promotion churn and coarse-lock footprint. The r012 test of the same default pair was refuted only while the WAL commit-path bundle was simultaneously perturbed; with the accepted WAL bundle now fixed, this isolates the SIRead granularity axis.
query_effect: GetUserTweets scans retain page-level SIRead locks instead of promoting to relation granularity, reducing per-scan lock bookkeeping and coarse-lock footprint.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase in successful transaction TPS as GetUserTweets terminal occupancy (0.865 of capacity) shrinks slightly.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 decreases; p50/p95 roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Default caps keep locks at page granularity longer, cutting promotion churn versus zero-cap immediate promotion.
Less promotion bookkeeping and smaller coarse-lock footprint shorten the dominant transaction's tail.
Freed terminal capacity from the dominant GetUserTweets class raises completed-transaction goodput.

alternatives.statement: Zero caps are already optimal; restoring defaults increases promotion churn and lowers TPS.
SIRead granularity is irrelevant at 0 lock waits; locks_total.p95 stays flat and TPS is unchanged.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent sits at the degenerate zero-cap extreme that maximizes promotion churn; the default pair is the untested interior point on the same axis with the accepted WAL bundle held fixed, isolating the SIRead mechanism.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: PostgreSQL default 2, inside allowed [0,256]; reverses incumbent 0 extreme toward the default midpoint, one step from the degenerate zero-cap path.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: page-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 2 retains page-level SIRead locks longer before promotion

knob_changes.numerical_basis: PostgreSQL default -2, inside allowed [-2,4096]; -2 derives the relation cap as a fraction of the per-txn budget instead of the degenerate zero cap.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: relation-level predicate-lock granularity cap; -2 uses the default fraction of the per-txn SIRead budget

nodes.label: Default SIRead granularity reduces promotion churn and coarse-lock footprint per GetUserTweets

cross_domain_requirements: Hold the accepted WAL commit-path bundle (commit_delay=0, commit_siblings=20, wal_writer_flush_after=256) fixed to isolate the SIRead axis.
